state.name: tea_hold
state.description: How strongly the tea holds Elaris inside the book this session. Set at brew to min(100, 40 + 10 x depth). Drains by page beats and idle time. 60+ first person; 30-59 fading third person; 1-29 thin; 0 the page closes.

state.name: pov
state.description: Narration state derived from tea_hold: first ('I'), fading ('he'), thin, closed (back in the temple).

state.name: brew.depth
state.description: Depth of the last brew: sum of herb depth x steep factor. Sets starting tea_hold; each book needs a minimum.

state.name: brew.length
state.description: Length of the last brew. Lowers page-beat drain on tea_hold.

state.name: brew.binding
state.description: Binding of the last brew. Added to steep as 3 x binding when brewed. Can be negative.

state.name: steep
state.description: How far Elaris has steeped himself in reading across the run. 60+ lets the last cup keep him (The Reader Who Stayed).

state.name: sips
state.description: Sips taken inside a book to hold the tea (max 2 per session). +4 steep each.

state.name: lingers
state.description: Times Elaris read on past a mark instead of setting the cup down. +8 steep each.

state.name: returns
state.description: Times Elaris set the cup down at a mark. -6 steep each.

state.name: duties_done
state.description: Keeper's duties done in the hub (sweeping sand, winding the clock, shelving, dusting). -3 steep each.

state.name: sand_leak
state.description: How much sand the nameless book spills into the temple. +15 per Book One session; -10 per sweep. 60+ drifts in the stacks; 80+ harder waves in the last ride.

state.name: herbs
state.description: Herbs found for the pantry, in order.

state.name: motifs
state.description: Motif words met while reading, the tiles for The Naming.

state.name: names_given
state.description: Books Elaris has named.

state.name: rules_broken
state.description: Rules a narrator broke openly instead of finding a loophole.

state.name: tablet_scrutiny
state.description: Scrutiny on the current Rule Tablet: +20 per failed test, reset per appearance. At 100 a watcher adds one rule.

state.name: loophole_shrine
state.description: Book One: the shrine-store tablet solved without breaking a rule.

state.name: fathers_things
state.description: Xandri took his father's leaf-cord and waterskin (by loophole or by breaking the rule).

state.name: leaf_shoes
state.description: Xandri has tied the Zorlop leaves to his feet.

state.name: swallowed_count
state.description: Times a wave swallowed Xandri in the living illustration.

state.name: father_mark_reached
state.description: Xandri reached his father's last camp and marker.

state.name: loophole_wake
state.description: The gods' rules tablet solved: Xandri may walk the Xandrixes' track on leaf shoes without breaking a rule.

state.name: passed_father_mark
state.description: Xandri walked further than his father did.

state.name: xandri_fate
state.description: Book One's central choice at the herd.

state.name: book1_named
state.description: Elaris named the sand book himself.

state.name: loophole_hollin
state.description: Book Two: the Clerk's Charter solved, opening the shared option.

state.name: hollin_choice
state.description: Book Two's choice.

state.name: book2_named
state.description: Elaris named the weather book.

state.name: loophole_procession
state.description: Book Three: the Procession's vows solved, opening the end option.

state.name: procession_choice
state.description: Book Three's choice.

state.name: book3_named
state.description: Elaris named the road book.

state.name: clasps_opened
state.description: Sealed temple books opened with The Clasps.

state.name: past_fragments
state.description: Fragments of Elaris's past found in the temple. Slots: where, vow, cost, judgment, mercy, remains (plus the dream).

state.name: past_known
state.description: How many of the seven past fragments the player holds (0-7).

state.name: black_book_open
state.description: The black book on the unlit shelf has been opened.

state.name: candle_left
state.description: Elaris left a candle burning at the black book. -10 steep.

state.name: last_cup
state.description: The final choice in the reading chair.
